description.p: A welcome application for new users of Soplos Linux. Provides easy access to common system configuration and software installation tasks: driver setup, recommended applications, kernel management, security tools, customization and gaming optimizations.

Aplicación de bienvenida para nuevos usuarios de Soplos Linux. Proporciona acceso rápido a la configuración del sistema y tareas de instalación: instalación de controladores, aplicaciones recomendadas, gestión de kernels, herramientas de seguridad, personalización y optimizaciones para juegos.

Application d'accueil pour les nouveaux utilisateurs de Soplos Linux. Fournit un accès facile à la configuration du système et à l'installation de logiciels : pilotes, applications recommandées, gestion des noyaux, outils de sécurité, personnalisation et optimisations pour les jeux.

Willkommensanwendung für neue Benutzer von Soplos Linux. Bietet einfachen Zugriff auf gängige Systemkonfigurationen und Softwareinstallationen: Treiber, empfohlene Anwendungen, Kernelverwaltung, Sicherheitswerkzeuge, Anpassungen und Gaming-Optimierungen.

Aplicação de boas-vindas para novos utilizadores do Soplos Linux. Facilita o acesso à configuração do sistema e tarefas de instalação: controladores, aplicações recomendadas, gestão de kernels, ferramentas de segurança, personalização e otimizações para jogos.

Applicazione di benvenuto per i nuovi utenti di Soplos Linux. Offre facile accesso alla configurazione del sistema e alle attività di installazione: driver, applicazioni consigliate, gestione dei kernel, strumenti di sicurezza, personalizzazione e ottimizzazioni per i giochi.

Aplicație de bun venit pentru noii utilizatori de Soplos Linux. Oferă acces rapid la configurarea sistemului și instalarea software-ului: drivere, aplicații recomandate, gestionarea kernelurilor, securitate, personalizare și optimizări pentru jocuri.

Приложение приветствия для новых пользователей Soplos Linux. Обеспечивает быстрый доступ к настройке системы и установке программ: установка драйверов, рекомендуемые приложения, управление ядрами, безопасность, персонализация и оптимизация для игр.

description.p: The NVIDIA drivers, the PRIME mode and the kernel cleanup work with the three boot loaders of Soplos Linux Installer, GRUB, Limine and systemd-boot. The NVIDIA 620 branch replaces 590 and 610, and the GTX 1650 and 1660 get it instead of nouveau. GRUB Editor is greyed out when the system does not boot with GRUB.
Soplos Look Manager is listed in the Plasma tab of Customization, next to GRUB Editor and Plymouth Manager.

On a computer with an NVIDIA graphics card, the package installs a kernel hook that downloads the latest patches of the nvidia-patches project and applies them to the NVIDIA driver sources before DKMS builds the module, so the kernels that arrive from a terminal build it too.
New AI agents category in Recommended: OpenCode, Claude Code, llama.cpp, Ollama, DeepSeek Harness and 9router.
The window no longer has the frame of the system: it is a card with rounded corners and its own minimize, maximize and close buttons. New screenshots of every page.
New application icon: an open welcome box with the shield, the chip and the gamepad rising out of it, and the Soplos seal on the ribbon.
New application icon, new hero images and new screenshots, taken with the interface in English.
Fixed Google Antigravity version detection in the Recommended tab to read product ideVersion instead of the base Electron version.
Added the Heronite game launcher, written in Rust, to the Gaming tab.

Mac support in the hardware scan of the Drivers tab: on an Apple computer it offers mbpfan and TLP on MacBooks and the driver of the FaceTime HD camera (a community project, experimental). Nothing is shown on other computers.
The output of the terminal follows the light or dark theme instead of staying dark.
The window follows the light or dark theme of the desktop (Xfce, Plasma and GNOME); the button of the sidebar still lets you choose.
Fixed the gaming wallpapers installation, which copied nothing in the three desktops while reporting success.
OpenRGB is now installed from Debian together with its udev rules and the i2c-dev module, so it can reach the USB and I2C devices.
Added the NVIDIA DKMS patches for kernels 7.2+: Fix 6 for the Debian 550 driver and Fix 7 for the 590 open modules.

Fixed the Linux 7.3+ dmem cgroup patch (Fix 5), which was never applied because of a malformed hunk header, and the driver install order so the patches are applied before the first DKMS build can abort the script.
Added the Xodus Nexus (Xbox and Microsoft Store) and Epic Games launchers to Gaming, and the WordCraft, GridCraft, DeckCraft, DesignCraft and FigCraft apps to Recommended.
Added NVIDIA DKMS compatibility patch for Linux 7.3+ kernels (Fix 5: dmem_cgroup_register_region API change in os-interface.c).
Full 8-language internationalization across desktop launchers and AppStream metadata.
Added manual page documentation (soplos-welcome.1) installed to /usr/share/man/man1/.
Updated copyright formatting to DEP-5 and synchronized with upstream standards.
Fixed Wayland crash across all hardware GPUs.

ul.li: Disabled WebKitGTK DMA-BUF renderer by default to avoid Wayland protocol error 71

description.p: Soplos Software Center is now Soplos Store.

ul.li: Software tab entry renamed to Soplos Store, with its new name, package and icon

description.p: Soplos Software Center added to the Software tab.

ul.li: New Software tab entry: Soplos Software Center, next to Repo Selector

description.p: New Recommended applications and two Welcome bug fixes.

ul.li: New recommended application: ArtCraft Launcher, Storytold's own installer/updater for the whole Craft app suite, under App management
New recommended application: SoundCraft, the Craft suite's audio editor, under Multimedia
Security tab's Soplos Sys Cleaner entry now opens the basic program instead of the advanced one
Fixed Recommended's multi-select action bar hiding the window's progress strip during batch installs/uninstalls

description.p: Fixed two non-working Wi-Fi firmware/driver install buttons in Drivers.

ul.li: Ralink/MediaTek Wi-Fi firmware button did nothing: switched from firmware-ralink (no install candidate) to firmware-mediatek
Added a working install option for Broadcom Wi-Fi chips with no open driver (BCM4311, BCM4321, BCM43142 and others) via broadcom-sta-dkms

description.p: New Recommended applications and several VirtualBox/Audacity/Patchy fixes.

ul.li: New recommended applications: the ArtCraft suite (VectorCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft, LightCraft, PrintCraft) and VMware Workstation Pro
Audacity now installs from the official AppImage, since Audacity 4 dropped Debian packaging
Patchy always installs the latest release and shows the current official icon
Fixed VirtualBox Extension Pack install failing with a name mismatch error
Waydroid moved to the Virtualization category and blocked on X11 sessions, which it cannot run on
AppImage-based entries now register their version and update URL automatically with Soplos AppImage Manager
Fixed ES-DE installing a stale pinned version instead of the latest release
Every install/uninstall action in Recommended now shows a clear completion message

description.p: New recommended applications and a smaller installed package.

ul.li: New recommended applications: Concat, Glassy Music, Orchard and Sonora
Smaller installed package

description.p: First beta of the Tauri-based rewrite of Soplos Welcome.

ul.li: Interface available in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Romanian and Russian
New popup dialogs and faster Drivers, Security and Gaming sections
About 100 recommended applications, including Patchy, Fog Panther, WhatsApp and Telegram
System cleaning now keeps the Flatpak runtimes still in use
Clear confirmation before installing VirtualBox or its Extension Pack, since both add extra repositories or a separate license
Automatic fix for a blank window in virtual machines

description.p: Full architecture rewrite of Soplos Welcome, from Python 3 and GTK3 to Tauri 2 with a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend.
